title: Lottery – Western States Endurance Run
claims: The lottery was created to select the field fairly; registration is open for three weeks in November.
Applicants must have completed a qualifying race within the qualifying period and the allowed time.
Unsuccessful applicants accumulate 2^(n-1) tickets for each failed application, where n is the number of years applied.

claimVerification.note: 页面写明 lottery 的目的与 11 月三周报名窗口。
页面写明必须有 qualifying race。
页面给出 2^(n-1) 的票数公式并举例。
